seoTitle: Log to CSV Converter: Access Logs, logfmt, JSON Lines, Regex
metaDescription: Convert logs to CSV for a spreadsheet. Choose Common/Combined, an nginx or Apache format, logfmt, JSON lines or a custom regex. Free.
intro: Converts several common log formats to CSV with the columns you pick.
why:
Spreadsheets and SQL tools want columns. This tool parses the log and writes CSV with proper quoting, so user agents with commas survive.

For a custom regex, named groups become columns. Use the SQL on CSV tool or the XLSX converter on the result. Lines that do not match are skipped without a note, so compare line counts.
howTo: Paste the log or choose a file.
Pick the format and, if needed, enter a format string or regex.
Optionally list the columns to keep.

faq.a: Paste the CSV into the CSV to XLSX tool.

faq.q: Can I query it with SQL?
faq.a: Yes, paste the CSV into the SQL on CSV tool. It is not DuckDB, but runs common SELECT queries.
Lines that do not match the format are dropped.
